maria.s: Heads-up — unexpected surge in inference traffic hitting prod-uswest2 since ~21:40. Queue depth is spiking, p95 latency creeping up. Can we confirm standby A100 slots from the vendor for the next ~3h? We may need to pull a canary fallback if we can't get capacity.
liam.k: Do you have the quick metrics/logs?
maria.s: Quick tail from our queue monitor: ```
# tail -n 50 /var/log/inference/queue.log
2026-03-21T21:39:22Z queue_size=18 model=redwood-7B p95=210ms
2026-03-21T21:40:10Z queue_size=34 model=redwood-7B p95=310ms
2026-03-21T21:41:05Z queue_size=49 model=redwood-7B p95=420ms
```
ryan.t: Pinged vendor-bot and vendor-ops channel. If vendor can free slots, we'll hand them an SSH/handshake to attach to dedicated-burst pool. If not, we should flip routing to h100-small canary or route low-priority work to the dedicated fallback pool.
vendor-bot: vendor-ops: 3 x A100 freed in us-west2-1, status: AVAILABLE. ETA for provisioning to customer project: ~12 minutes. Reference: https://vendor.example.com/alloc/REQ-8342
liam.k: If that lands, we can reserve with terraform like: ```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "surge_temp" {
  region = "us-west2"
  gpu_type = "A100"
  count = 3
  tags = ["surge:manual", "incident:1715556666"]
}
```  I'll prep a tiny PR and tag infra-auto-approved for < 30m changes.
maria.s: I'll open PR now and request @liam.k review. Also switching canary routing requires a quick flag flip in the router: `--prefer-canary=h100-small` — want to avoid broad user-facing regressions.
ryan.t: Agree. If vendor delay > 20m we execute fallback: 1) route non-critical traffic to dedicated-burst, 2) enable looser KV-cache eviction tolerances to reduce cold starts, 3) notify SRE.
maria.s: Done — PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/8293. Marked it as emergency hotflip.
finance: Noted potential cost spike; please add chargeback tag `surge:manual` to resources and ping if this goes beyond 3 hours.
oncall: After swap, run quick smoke: `curl -sS https://prod-uswest2.redwood/api/health?model=redwood-7B | jq .latency.p95` — confirm p95 < 350ms and no >500ms errors. Report back here.
liam.k: Reviewing PR now. If vendor handshake completes, I'll apply and monitor.
maria.s: Thanks all — will post updates. :thumbsup:
ryan.t: If anything blocks vendor provisioning, I'll open the region-fallback runbook and start re-routing scripts.
vendor-bot: Allocation applied to project redwood-prod; handshake in progress — agents will notify when nodes are attached.
maria.s: Great. Keeping this thread as the coordination lane. Will update when nodes attach or when fallback kicks in.
